text.tspan: CyberChat · What can each person do on the platform?
Logical view (Kruchten's 4+1 model) designed for those who use the platform: the main functions and how they connect.
• Each person signs in with an account
• The platform reads and organizes them
• Only their company can use them
• They can be deleted or reprocessed
→ Feeds or leads to the next one
• Risk per person: low · medium · high
• Cached for 1 hour; can be regenerated
